searchText: GM all, would love to get some clarity on the spec here in regards to the term "partial withdrawal" when used between Capella and Electra: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/3911 cc: <@415109946682769408> left a comment in the issue Didn't seem like <@240180844130598912> said it explicitly....
